purpose: Local research corpus from news reports and one public-affairs turboprop clip. These are not validated geolocation ground truth.

recordings.title: USAF Thunderbirds flyover National Mall

event_region.label: National Mall and central Washington, DC

recordings.event_evidence: The publisher identifies the National Mall and says the flyover occurred Friday morning. Date is supported by the same-day publication; exact capture time is absent.
recordings.continuity: Unverified. The excerpt may contain studio narration, edits, or more than one camera/audio source.
recordings.suitability: Real broadcast stress test; jets may have weak or absent stable propeller-like harmonics. Not an accuracy benchmark.

recordings.title: Fat Albert Flyover With Silent Drill Platoon At MCAS Yuma (Landscape)
recordings.creator: Cpl. Gideon M. Schippers
recordings.event_evidence: The page separately declares Date Taken 02.26.2025 and Date Posted 03.19.2025 and places the photo shoot on the MCAS Yuma runway. Video ID 955827; VIRIN 250226-M-PP322-3753.
recordings.continuity: Produced public-affairs video; natural aircraft sound and absence of music/replaced audio still require review.
recordings.suitability: Prop-aircraft event candidate for acoustic detection; public date and runway region are useful, but no surveyed microphone location, UTC start, or flight trajectory has been established.
